text:
Ashley (support): need a single-use rate boost for partner P-246; live demo 14:00 PT (in ~2h). Org 98765, API key pk_live_987. Sales confirmed billing. Current caps: per-org qps 20, burst 50. Requesting qps=200 with burst=600 for a 30m window. Who can approve/apply?

Tom (platform): @Ashley ping — I can apply but need exact UTC window and ticket id. Also confirm token budget isn't going to be exhausted.

Ashley (support): Ticket #INC-4312. Window: 2026-03-18T21:00:00Z -> 2026-03-18T21:30:00Z (UTC). Payload below.

Ashley (support): ```json
{
  "org_id":"98765",
  "api_key":"pk_live_987",
  "override_type":"rate_boost",
  "qps":200,
  "burst":600,
  "expires_at":"2026-03-18T21:30:00Z",
  "reason":"partner live demo - sales approved INC-4312"
}
```

Tom (platform): two quick checks before apply: 1) routing policy — this key should still be routed to Dedicated pool if available (so we don't blow hosted capacity); 2) enable per-key tracing/telemetry for the window so we can spot regressions. I'll apply via admin API once confirmed.

Tom (platform): Applying now via `POST /admin/overrides` with that payload; will post audit link when done.

quota-bot: Override created id ov-20260318-77 by Tom (platform); status=scheduled; audit=https://admin.redwood.internal/overrides/ov-20260318-77

Maria (sre): FYI — I'll monitor p50/p95 and 5xx rates for the partner routes. If 5xx > 1% or p50 > 300ms for >2m we should revoke.

Ashley (salesops): Thanks. Confirm rollback plan: automatic expiry at 21:30 UTC and manual revoke available if we see anomalies. Also want a short customer-facing note template in case the demo sees hiccups.

Tom (platform): Rollback = auto-expire at 21:30 UTC. Manual revoke endpoint: `DELETE /admin/overrides/{id}`. I'll keep this thread updated during the window. :thumbsup:

Maria (sre): Creating a minimal dashboard: panels for qps by key, errors by route, and gpu/cpu util. Will post link in ~5m.

Tom (platform): Dashboard ready: https://grafana.internal/d/ov/partner-demo-98765?from=now-1h

Ashley (support): Passing to sales + partner. Please log any observations in INC-4312 so we have a single source of truth.

Ashley (support): Quick process note — this flow is still clunky; would be great to have a one-click console action for "temporary demo boost" that 1) creates override, 2) triggers telemetry, and 3) attaches to the ticket.

Tom (platform): Agreed — created backlog ticket PLAT-889 to explore a canned demo-boost UX with templated approvals and audit steps.

Ashley (support): thanks all, will follow up after the demo with results.
